name: Major Arcana
summary: Numbered 0 to XXI, these are the big themes: turning points, life lessons, and archetypes that show up in everyone’s life. When a Major appears, it often points to something larger than the day-to-day.

name: Minor Arcana
summary: Four suits of 14 cards each. These are the everyday: the moods, choices, and situations that fill ordinary days. Each suit runs from Ace to Ten, plus four court cards: Page, Knight, Queen, and King.
